backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining firms, job postings, user profiles, and per-user job tracking with access control and initialization of Big 4 firms.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking features to files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based theme variables and styles for light/dark modes using a neutral OKLCH palette.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, React Query provider, theme provider, and app layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Wraps content in an admin-only guard, showing a loading spinner or access-denied message when appropriate.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: First-time user profile setup modal that saves name and email and blocks closing until completed.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Authentication guard that displays a sign-in prompt when the user is not logged in.
frontend/src/components/common/EmptyStat: Displays a centered empty state with optional illustration, title, description, and action slot.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobDetailsD: Shows a dialog with job details and allows authenticated users to save, update status, and edit notes for a job.
Provides the main layout with navigation, authentication-aware links, and admin-only sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnalytics.ts: Defines analytics queries for job counts, categories, trends, and user-specific status breakdowns using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirms.ts: Provides a mutation to add or update firm records and invalidates firm-related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity auth state, including login, logout, identity loading, and context exposure.
frontend/src/hooks/useJobTracking.ts: Fetches and saves per-user job tracking data such as saved status, notes, and application state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides queries and mutations for jobs, firms, bulk import, and user roles, backed by the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Fetches and saves the authenticated user's profile, invalidating cached data after updates.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base setup defining light and dark mode CSS variables and global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminFirmsPage.tsx: Admin interface to view, create, and edit firms with form dialog and validation.
frontend/src/pages/AdminJobsPage.tsx: Admin page to list, create, and close job postings using form dialogs and firm lookup.
frontend/src/pages/BulkImportPage.tsx: Admin tool for importing multiple jobs via CSV parsing and validation.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard displaying charts for open jobs, user status, and posting trends using analytics hooks.
frontend/src/pages/JobBoardPage.tsx: Public job board with search, filtering, and job details dialog for open positions.
frontend/src/pages/MyTrackerPage.tsx: React page that loads user job-tracking data, filters saved jobs by status, and displays them with a details dialog and status selector; requires authentication.
frontend/src/utils/csvImport.ts: Parses CSV text into row objects and validates required job posting fields such as title, firm, category, location, and URL.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from hash-based routes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, breakpoints, shadows, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing requirements, features, and app goals for a job-tracking and posting management tool.
